text: The purpose of this report is to provide City Council with the Operating Variance for the nine months ended September 30, 2025, as well as projections to the year-end, December 31, 2025. This report also requests City Council's approval for amendments to the 2025 Approved Operating Budget that have no impact on the City's Net Budget. The following table summarizes the year-to-date financial position and year-end projections for the City's Tax-Supported Operations as of September 30, 2025.
